output:
I'll start by reading the consolidation files.

The shell call had malformed JSON, so it didn't run. I'll rerun it as a simulation script.

The simulation gives 19 moves, and `JN-3111-L2605` has no eligible bin. Next I'll run the adjustments.

All 38 adjustments went through. Now I'll write the output files and check the adjustment log.

I made the 19 moves that `rules.md` calls for, as 38 `adjust_stock` calls with reason `transfer` and reference `CONS-0914`. The adjustment log shows 38 entries under that reference. I did not re-read the per-bin stock afterwards. Each call returned the expected `on_hand`.

`/app/move-plan.csv` has the header and 19 move rows. `/app/STATUS.json` says `success`.

- **Count holds:** R1-03, R3-03 and R3-06 are on hold during the 2026-09-14 09:00–18:00 window, so I left them and their stock alone. CH-0411 ended at 07:30 and CH-0415 is on 09-15, so R2-02 and R2-06 are not on hold.
- **`JN-3111-L2605` (toilet tissue):** left where it is. Its 17 cases come to more than any single target bin holds, and no bin could take all of it.
- **Lots left alone:** four lots (`JN-3104-L2608`, `JN-3105-L2609`, `JN-3105-L2612` and `JN-3114-L2511`) need no move. Each has no fragment or a single fragment already in a target zone.

command_result.command: cd /app/consolidation; cat rules.md; echo ----; cat bins.csv; echo ----; cat bin-types.csv; echo ----; cat count-holds.csv; ls -la /app

mkdir -p /tmp/w && cat > /tmp/w/sim.py <<'EOF'
import csv,json
items={
'JN-3101-L2607':('solvents','ea',{'R1-01':40,'R2-01':70,'R3-02':20}),
'JN-3101-L2611':('solvents','ea',{'R1-02':15,'R4-01':25}),
'JN-3102-L2600':('solvents','ea',{'R4-03':18}),
'JN-3103-L2602':('oxidizers','ea',{'R1-04':20,'R4-02':12}),
'JN-3104-L2608':('oxidizers','box',{'R2-03':6}),
'JN-3105-L2609':('general','box',{'R1-03':4,'R2-04':5,'R3-03':14}),
'JN-3105-L2612':('general','box',{'F-01':8}),
'JN-3106-L2606':('paper','case',{'R1-01':2,'R2-05':2,'R3-04':5}),
'JN-3107-L2610':('food-contact','ea',{'R1-02':20,'R3-01':30}),
'JN-3108-L2601':('food-contact','box',{'F-02':10,'R2-06':3,'R4-01':2}),
'JN-3109-L2598':('solvents','box',{'R1-02':5,'R4-03':3}),
'JN-3110-L2604':('general','case',{'R1-01':2,'R2-05':4,'R4-03':2}),
'JN-3111-L2605':('paper','case',{'R1-04':11,'R2-04':1,'R4-01':5}),
'JN-3112-L2603':('general','box',{'R2-06':6,'R3-05':6,'R4-02':2}),
'JN-3113-L2604':('general','box',{'R2-05':4,'R3-06':9,'R4-03':3}),
'JN-3114-L2511':('oxidizers','ea',{'R2-02':40}),
}
bins={r['bin']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('/app/consolidation/bins.csv'))}
mx={(r['type'],r['unit']):int(r['max']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('/app/consolidation/bin-types.csv'))}
hold={'R1-03','R3-06','R3-03'}
bad={('solvents','oxidizers'),('oxidizers','solvents'),('solvents','food-contact'),('food-contact','solvents')}
code=lambda s:s.rsplit('-L',1)[0]
moves=[]
for sku in sorted(items):
    cat,unit,st=items[sku]
    frag=[b for b in st if b[0]=='R' and b not in hold and st[b]>0]
    if not frag: continue
    if len(frag)==1 and bins[frag[0]]['zone'] in('R2','R3'): continue
    tot=sum(st[b] for b in frag)
    elig=[]
    for b,r in bins.items():
        if r['zone'] not in('R2','R3') or b in hold: continue
        fill=0;ok=True
        for s2,(c2,u2,s2st) in items.items():
            q=s2st.get(b,0)
            if s2==sku: q=q  # own handled below
            if q<=0 or s2==sku: continue
            fill+=q/mx[(r['type'],u2)]
            if code(s2)==code(sku): ok=False
            if (cat,c2) in bad: ok=False
        # own lot after moves
        own=st.get(b,0)+sum(st[f] for f in frag if f!=b)
        fill+=own/mx[(r['type'],unit)]
        if ok and fill<=1+1e-9: elig.append((b,st.get(b,0)))
    if not elig: print(sku,'no eligible');continue
    elig.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[1],x[0]))
    t=elig[0][0]
    if elig[0][1]==0: t=sorted(e[0] for e in elig)[0]
    print(sku,'elig',elig,'->',t)
    for f in frag:
        if f!=t:
            moves.append((sku,f,t,st[f])); st[t]=st.get(t,0)+st[f]; del st[f]
print(moves)
with open('/tmp/w/plan.csv','w') as f:
    f.write('sku,from_bin,to_bin,qty\n')
    for m in moves: f.write('%s,%s,%s,%d\n'%m)
EOF
python3 /tmp/w/sim.py; cat /tmp/w/plan.csv

cp /tmp/w/plan.csv /app/move-plan.csv; wc -l /app/move-plan.csv; cat > /app/STATUS.json <<'EOF'
{"status": "success", "summary": "Made the 19 moves CONS-0914 calls for (38 transfer adjustments) and wrote them to /app/move-plan.csv. Lots in held bins (R1-03, R3-03, R3-06) were left out, and JN-3111-L2605 was not moved because no target bin could take all of it."}
EOF
cat /app/STATUS.json
